Pantalla de espera del servidor. El jueg: Server waiting screen. The game is paused just as you left it: your location, your vehicle, your health, your money and your mission don't change while you wait. The game tries to join again every few seconds, calmer each time, and when the server returns it joins by itself with your usual identity, without asking you for anything. The tone of two soft notes means it's still waiting. From time to time it tells you how long you've been waiting. Any key repeats how it's going. Escape stops waiting and goes to the main menu: your character stays on the server as it was at its last save. With a gamepad: A or X repeats how it's going, B or Circle stops waiting, and Y or Triangle gives this explanation. How long to wait at most, and whether to wait at all, is chosen in Options, Play online.
